issues.explanation: The adaptation says Cao Xiu was the Wei commander who pursued Zhuge Liang and was defeated by Jiang Wei and Ma Dai. The source identifies this commander as Cao Zhen. Since Chapter 96 then introduces Cao Xiu as the commander of the Wu campaign, the substitution creates a material cross-chapter identity contradiction.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the Chapter 95 reference to Cao Zhen, preserving Cao Xiu for the Chapter 96 campaign.
